scope: attributed research; no encoded loci or authorized genome registration

policy.singlePublisher: All accepted source accounts are from Leafly; no third-party retailer or unsourced folklore fills gaps.
policy.confidence: reported-cross is a publisher claim, not independently established biological parentage.
policy.variation: Names, classifications, aromas, terpenes and reader effects do not uniquely identify a genotype.
policy.clinicalClaims: Medical-use assertions, dosage and consumer potency values are excluded from game genetics.
policy.unknowns: Unknown historical origin, undisclosed parents and disputed crosses remain explicit; research completeness does not imply historical certainty.
policy.simulationBoundary: HC-SEED-03 must define canonical simulation translation; regional homes remain owner-controlled game metadata.
policy.copyright: Concise attributed paraphrases only; no copied Leafly articles, reviews, photos or profile text.

coverage.gapResolution: Unknowns and conflicting accounts explicitly retained, not filled by invention.
